DLC2321:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $n. Your training is as grueling as ever.」

DLC2321:3:t_1:6.en:
$n
「Everyone's helping me with mock battles. I have to live up to that.」

DLC2321:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... So everyone is trying to improve before the next battle.」

DLC2321:3:t_1:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to lend a hand as well.」

DLC2321:3:t_1:9.en:
$n
「You're going to spar with me too?」

DLC2321:3:t_1:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With a wild grin like that on your face, I most certainly decline!」

DLC2321:3:t_1:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I shall assist in a way only I can.」

DLC2321:3:t_1:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I have prepared a fiendish simulator packed with powerful enemies. This time, the stage will be on the ground.」

DLC2321:3:t_1:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since this is training, most of the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s event control will be disabled...」

DLC2321:3:t_1:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I have specially prepared ten A-Adapters, so please use them when preparing to deploy.」

DLC2321:3:t_2:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How was that, $n? Good training, wasn't it?」

DLC2321:3:t_2:6.en:
$$メール$$
「Still, it's amazing. To think all that was a simulation.」

DLC2321:3:t_2:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Could we even get out of our machines and have something to eat and drink?」

DLC2321:3:t_2:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally. Anything less would not be true virtual reality.」

DLC2321:3:t_2:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even $$キリコ$$'s $$アーマーマグナム$$ is reproduced perfectly, wouldn't you agree?」

DLC2321:3:t_2:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「So if I drink a beer...」

DLC2321:3:t_2:11.en:
$$メール$$
「You can get drunk! This'll be a big help with the household budget!」

DLC2321:3:t_2:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I guess you can't bring money you earn virtually back into the real world...」

DLC2321:3:t_2:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Right! Enough penny-pinching talk. Let us prepare for the next battle!」

DLC2321:3:t_2:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone! Thank you for your hard work!」

DLC2321:4:t_000:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Amazing. The simulator has recreated $$アクエリア市$$ perfectly.」

DLC2321:4:t_000:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The city is empty, though, so feel free to go as wild as you please.」

DLC2321:4:t_000:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have prepared opponents worthy of the occasion.」

DLC2321:4:t_001:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「$$バンドック$$! Is the $$コンピュータードール#keyword$$ aboard!?」

DLC2321:4:t_001:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「That land battleship... It appears to be controlled by a $$ワイズマン#keyword$$ terminal.」

DLC2321:4:t_001:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ガラダブラ$$ and the $$ミケーネ神$$s! Now these are worthy opponents!」

DLC2321:4:t_001:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$... I never expected to fight him again, even in a simulation.」

DLC2321:4:t_001:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ベック$$ has certainly come up in the world to be included in this company.」

DLC2321:4:t_001:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「The Angel that took $$綾波$$ is here too...」

DLC2321:4:t_001:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How is that for a star-studded lineup?」

DLC2321:4:t_001:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, everyone! Let us give this our all!」

DLC2321:4:t_003:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's about all there is to it.」

DLC2321:4:t_003:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「As we are now, that much is a piece of cake.」

DLC2321:4:t_003:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Whatever's waiting for us up ahead, nothing's gonna stop us.」

DLC2321:4:t_003:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But the universe is vast... Do not forget that the enemies you are likely to encounter will be beyond imagination.」

DLC2321:4:t_100:0.en:
$$タケル$$
（If I can't defeat $$ゲシュタルト$$, I'll never stand a chance against $$ズール$$...!）

DLC2321:4:t_100:1.en:
$$タケル$$
（Just wait, $$ズール$$...! This time, I'll settle things with you!）

DLC2321:4:t_101:0.en:
$$勝平$$
（$$ガイゾック$$! I don't know how many of you are out there in the universe, but come and get me!）

DLC2321:4:t_101:1.en:
$$勝平$$
（If you're going to decide for yourselves that humans are evil, then I'll just have to fight you!）

DLC2321:4:t_102:0.en:
$$キリコ$$
（Knowing you, $$ワイズマン#keyword$$... I am sure you are still stubbornly alive...）

DLC2321:4:t_102:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
（I do not care what you do. But trying to make me obey you is pointless.）

DLC2321:4:t_103:0.en:
$$甲児$$
（Here I come, $$ガラダブラ$$! I'll defeat you, then take on $$ハーデス$$!）

DLC2321:4:t_103:1.en:
$$甲児$$
（No matter how many times you come back, we'll crush your ambitions!）

DLC2321:4:t_104:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
（Now then, $$ベック$$... Where are you, and what are you doing in the real world...?）

DLC2321:4:t_104:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
（Live as you please. But if you commit any crimes in front of me, be prepared for the consequences.）

DLC2321:4:t_105:0.en:
$$宗介$$
（$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$... It is not as though I entirely failed to understand what you were trying to do...）

DLC2321:4:t_105:1.en:
$$宗介$$
（But we rejected it. That is why we will keep fighting to make the future even a little better...!）

DLC2321:4:t_106:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
（I... won't forget... what happened when I fought this Angel...）

DLC2321:4:t_106:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
（Where... am I going from here...?）

review.context: AG provides a ground-based simulator full of former bosses; the team considers its virtual realism and resolves to confront future or surviving enemies.
decisions: Shinji refers to an Evangelion Angel, kept distinct from Heralds.
Boss on the Ground is a simulator event title, not the character Boss.
